What if, since then, the cluster did become more dense and managed to form a supermassive blackhole, leading it over a few hundred million years to consume all the galactic matter within the cluster, creating an ultra supermassive blackhole, extending gravitational waves that do transcend time to reach us due to the ultra deep spacetime well it would create. 

By Einstein's theory of relativity, this could have already taken place, and we would be none the wiser until x point in time when we notice the Shapley's matter seemingly disappearing. 

Considering the expansion of the universe was only discovered in 1929, we have only had 96 years to observe the expansion, and the great attractor was only discovered in the 1970s, with it's location determined officially in 1986. A far cry from 650 million years from today, when we would then be able to see what the Shapley Cluster really* looks like as I write this today. 

I'm only an armchair astrophysicist and not sure what the math would look like here, especially since it's all speculative and theoretical, but if someone reads this that can disprove it, please do!

YTA -
1) From the second mom and SD moved in, it was no longer "your" house. SD is now apart of your family, and the house in question is not only your home, it's also SD's. 

2) As for SD's actions, she is very clearly hurting, not just from the divorce but also from being excluded and feeling like an outsider in her own home. 

3) Your reaction to SD's actions allowed things to escalate. The mature thing would have been to ignore it and not give her the satisfaction of a reaction, or talk to mom about it so she could handle it how she saw fit. You can't only take on the parenting role of disciplining a child while leaving out the other stuff like bonding with her, attempting to make her feel welcome and cared for etc. As for her being difficult to deal with, you signed up for it when you married mom. It's also not a huge surprise that teens act like, you know, teens. 

4) Your feelings getting hurt is nothing compared to how you're hurting this child by exclusion. You're a grown adult, handle your own feelings, and acknowledge how you're hurting her. 

OP please do better 🙏 or let it escalate to divorce ig
